description: Shows one trip from a find_trips answer step by step, door to door: leaving home, the train or bus to the airport, the airport wait, the flight, the transfer into the city and arrival, then the way back, with local times. Also gives the booking link and a calendar file (.ics) the user can add. Pass a trip id from the find_trips answer ("Trip ids, row by row", or a row's `id`). Use it when the user picks a trip or asks how the journey works. Ids are kept for 72 hours.

trip_id.description: A trip id from the find_trips answer, e.g. "t_k3m9q2xa".
trip_id.title: Trip Id
